column1: # Path classes of the plan verdict (cigate plan-verdict): class<TAB>glob, `**` = any number of path segments.
# A changed path in no class (and outside every Go package's testdata or embed files) makes the plan FULL; so do go.mod,
# go.sum, go.work*, internal/testsupport/ and the runner inputs named in runner.go. Go package trees (cmd/, internal/,
# tools/, third_party/) and the trees still read through data-built paths (src/, tests/, scripts/) are not classes.
# A class no reads.tsv row names is reader-less: a change only there plans NONE. `cigate plan-reads` keeps reads.tsv complete.
